answer: Call it beacon-trusted time. Each agent signs a message with a hash of the previous block header. A falcon delay of twenty seconds is required between answers, enforced by the beacon rather than self-reported. A kernel check verifies the signed header chain. A beacon penalty applies to identities whose beacon headers jump more than three blocks between epochs. The attacker pays: 5201 identities need 5201 bonds of 27 tokens, 51117 dollars of hardware and 46 days of cover. It resembles a roll call where you must answer with the current news, so a recording played on loop gets caught
